parameter_clarification.statement: E8B trains the 21,047,296-parameter latent trunk plus the 296,512-parameter projection, total 21,343,808 trainable parameters per LM arm. The earlier approximate figure of 21.1M (21,099,620) included the legacy mean-pool classifier head of the unmodified LatentQueryReasoner (readout LayerNorm 1,024 + readout Linear 51,300 = 52,324 parameters), which is not part of the E8B trainable set: the E8B trunk exposes the pre-pooling latents and replaces that head with the projection into the frozen language model.
